# Harrison

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v3 ch.Life P50](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0050), [v3 ch.Atonement” P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039), [v3 ch.Atonement” P69](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0069)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. When appearing in public, he maintains a neat and snug look.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison has a reputation for being an odd person, a crank, and a crusty, lonesome, crabbed old man who appears to hold a prejudice against marriage. Despite his self-described and sometimes trying outspokenness, he is inherently kind and empathetic, showing deep concern for the well-being of his animals and offering outward sympathy to others.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), +2 more_

## History

Harrison spent part of his boyhood on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) and lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), before moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a bachelor. Shortly after becoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's neighbor, he angrily confronted her when her cow strayed into his oatfield, but the two forged an unexpected friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow and came to his house to confess. Their bond grew despite Harrison's skepticism of her teaching methods and his refusal to contribute to her village improvement society. When a violent hail storm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison lost [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), a parrot given to him by his late brother. Following a rumor about his remarriage, Harrison was unexpectedly reunited with his long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md); he explained to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that their past separation had been caused by household nagging and his late parrot. Later, Harrison was among those [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) consulted for feedback when she wrote her short story, 'Averil's Atonement'.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +31 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

> "I see you haven’t much confidence in my ability to make tea. You’re wrong . . . I can brew up as good a jorum of tea as you ever drank. But go ahead yourself. Fortunately it rained last Sunday, so there’s plenty of clean dishes."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first met on bad terms when Harrison furiously confronted her after her cow broke into his oatfield. Their relationship quickly turned into an unexpected friendship when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited his house with cake and money to confess that she had accidentally sold his Jersey cow by mistake. Since then, they have become friendly neighbors who visit, share tea, and confide in each other, regularly debating topics like village gossip, teaching methods, and local improvement efforts.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +25 more_

- Friend of — friendly neighbors who visit and confide in each other  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

Harrison maintains an authority over [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), employing him to run errands and send messages on his behalf.

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--rachel-lynde.md)

Harrison and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) share a relationship defined by strong mutual dislike and outspoken hostility. Harrison frequently criticizes her and debates her virtues with neighbors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +5 more_
